name: smart-turret-ammo
title: Smart Turret Ammo
author: Crosstowndonkey
description: Gun, rocket, railgun and artillery turrets (and artillery wagons) keep themselves stocked with the best ammo in reach: construction robots bring it from the logistic network, and on space platforms the hub throws it across. Worse ammo is swapped for better automatically. Works with modded turrets and ammo; never uses nukes.
